strict "transition must be a direct child of <document> or <section>"
check that rejects the trailing ``----`` emitted by
sphinxcontrib-towncrier's draft-entries directive. That trailing
transition is wrapped inside the section that hosts the directive in
docs/changes.rst, so the new check fails the ``-W`` docs/spelling
build. Sphinx 9.1 accepts docutils >=0.20,<0.23, so hold docutils at
<0.22 in requirements/doc.txt until sphinxcontrib-towncrier stops
emitting the trailing transition (or docutils relaxes the check).
